title: PromptQueued
description: A prompt is waiting for the running turn to end. The queue is the backend's, not the SDK's — a prompt handed to the SDK cannot be taken back (plan 08, D-14) — so every watcher sees the same queue, and any of them can take one out with `session.cancelQueuedPrompt`.

position.description: Its place in the queue, from 1.

preview.description: The start of what was typed, for the row of the queue. Cut by the backend; the whole prompt is the turn's, when it runs.
